📖 How to use

  1. Enter the loan amount, upfront fees, nominal rate and term in months.
  2. The tool bisects the present-value equation to find the true APR.
  3. Compare the APR against the nominal rate and your monthly payment.

❓ Frequently asked questions

APR vs nominal rate — what is the difference?

Nominal rate is the advertised rate used to compute your payment; APR adds upfront fees into the true cost of borrowing, so APR is higher whenever fees are charged.

How is the true APR solved?

The APR is the monthly rate r that makes the present value of all payments equal the net cash you receive (loan amount minus upfront fees), solved numerically by bisection and annualized.

Why is my APR higher than the quoted rate?

When fees are zero, APR equals the nominal rate exactly. Any origination or processing fee paid up front pushes the true APR above the nominal rate.
